name: DeviceInfoChannels
description: TauSync meeting-word identifiers for device info channel reads. Each field that can be pushed by either side is split by direction so both parties can push simultaneously without colliding on the same meeting-word. Both PC and Android must call tau.connect() with the exact same string — define them here once and generate both sides.

members.name: ID
members.description: Bidirectional ID handshake channel: Android writes its current ID (or empty string for new devices), PC reads it and writes back the assigned ID on the same stream. Not split by direction because both parties read AND write within the same tau.connect() session.

members.name: NAME_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android pushes its human-readable device name to PC, e.g. "Pixel 8 Pro".

members.name: NAME_FROM_PC
members.description: PC pushes its human-readable device name to Android, e.g. "Lavi's Laptop". Reserved for future bidirectional device info exchange.

members.name: OS_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android pushes its OS version string to PC, e.g. "Android 14".

members.name: OS_FROM_PC
members.description: PC pushes its OS version string to Android, e.g. "Windows 11". Reserved for future bidirectional device info exchange.

members.name: TAG_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android pushes its user-assigned label to PC, e.g. "Home".

members.name: TAG_FROM_PC
members.description: PC pushes its user-assigned label to Android. Reserved for future bidirectional device info exchange.

members.name: LAST_SEEN_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android pushes a human-readable recency string to PC, e.g. "now", "today", "3 days ago".

members.name: LAST_SEEN_FROM_PC
members.description: PC pushes a human-readable recency string to Android. Reserved for future bidirectional device info exchange.

members.name: BATTERY_LEVEL_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android pushes its battery level as an integer percentage (0-100) to PC.

members.name: BATTERY_LEVEL_FROM_PC
members.description: PC pushes its battery level to Android (relevant for laptops). Reserved for future bidirectional device info exchange.

members.name: BATTERY_CHARGING_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android pushes whether it is currently charging to PC.

members.name: BATTERY_CHARGING_FROM_PC
members.description: PC pushes whether it is currently charging to Android. Reserved for future bidirectional device info exchange.

members.name: STORAGE_USED_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android pushes its used storage in bytes to PC.

members.name: STORAGE_USED_FROM_PC
members.description: PC pushes its used storage in bytes to Android. Reserved for future bidirectional device info exchange.

members.name: STORAGE_TOTAL_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android pushes its total storage capacity in bytes to PC.

members.name: STORAGE_TOTAL_FROM_PC
members.description: PC pushes its total storage capacity in bytes to Android. Reserved for future bidirectional device info exchange.

members.name: IP_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android pushes its last known LAN IP address to PC, used to reconnect.

members.name: IP_FROM_PC
members.description: PC pushes its last known LAN IP address to Android. Reserved for future bidirectional device info exchange.
